question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin add a first-party BM25/vector hybrid retrieval mode and config surface, or should advanced hybrid/rerank behavior remain an external ClawHub memory plugin concern?
rationale: The requested behavior is feasible in the plugin boundary but adds a new retrieval mode, config/default surface, ranking behavior, and dependency contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow official-plugin parity
options.body: Add BM25/vector hybrid search inside memory-lancedb only, preserve vector-only compatibility fallback, and keep advanced external rerankers out of this issue.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub memory plugins
options.body: Close or redirect this feature to an external memory plugin such as the previously posted enhanced LanceDB plugin, leaving official memory-lancedb vector-only.

options.title: Keep open pending API proof
options.body: Require a short design note proving the @lancedb/lancedb 0.30.0 FTS/hybrid API, migration/fallback behavior, and default config before implementation starts.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow official-plugin parity
recommendation.body: Add BM25/vector hybrid search inside memory-lancedb only, preserve vector-only compatibility fallback, and keep advanced external rerankers out of this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing candidate from file history and prior maintainer-side review context on this exact issue.
